prompt:
Generate a single game sprite: An animation sprite sheet: exactly four frames side by side in one row of four equal cells, no \
gaps, no borders, no numbers. Every frame shows exactly the robot in the attached sprite, same size, same \
position in its cell, same chair, same camera angle and light; only its hands and fingers move, as a looping typing cycle on the laptop keyboard.

instructions: You are a sprite generator. Always answer by calling the image_generation tool exactly once. Do not reply with text.
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background game animation sprite sheet in one single PNG: exactly four frames arranged side by side in one row of four equal cells, with no gaps, no borders, no separators, no numbers, no text. Each frame shows the same stylized 3D isometric robot at a laptop, matching the attached reference: cute rounded white/silver robot with glossy black face screen and two cyan glowing oval eyes, seated in a black office chair with armrests and five-wheel base, typing on a dark gray laptop. Same robot size, same position within each cell, same chair, laptop, camera angle, lighting, and composition across all frames. Only the robot's hands and fingers change pose between frames, forming a seamless looping typing cycle on the laptop keyboard: frame 1 left fingers down/right slightly raised, frame 2 alternate right fingers down/left raised, frame 3 both hands shifted subtly inward with different fingers depressed, frame 4 returns toward frame 1 with hands subtly outward. Style must match the reference concept art exactly: soft clean slightly stylized 3D render, isometric office object, three-quarter view from above about 30 degrees down, warm soft key light from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, pale desaturated palette, smooth rounded forms, glossy face, subtle bevels. Render only the robot, chair, and laptop, centered, whole and uncropped in every cell, on a fully transparent background: no floor, no ground shadow, no backdrop, no extra props.
